description: Known canonical-run artifact exceptions for the Milestone 1 V2 training run.

exceptions.defect_description: last_checkpoint.pt reports epoch 42 but contains epoch-22 best weights; the model state dict matches best_checkpoint.pt (SHA256=734247cb1e843b51c3049fe3e9525ff7046bce07ce0f9587fe0104f8d12c9209)
exceptions.rationale: Training script bug in commit 2899f8b saved last_checkpoint.pt after reloading best weights for final evaluation. The last checkpoint file contains the best-epoch (22) weights instead of the final-epoch (42) weights. Fixed in tooling commit 8f91979. This exception is registered to allow Gate PASS for the canonical run only.
